meta: Client Site: Deniz Construction Limited, Ishanyu Bushenyi Road, Mbarara

blocks.text: This guide locates the DCMS requirements deliverables and records how the presentation follows the SWE2102 guide. Document preparation, implementation verification and stakeholder acceptance are separate activities. A completed document does not mean every target feature is implemented or accepted by the business.

blocks.text: Existing requirement identifiers remain the formal traceability references. The stories are group-authored formulations derived from those requirements, not additional stakeholder testimony. Verification references and outstanding acceptance work are in Sections 5.4 and 5.5 of the master document.

The hosted web application is configured at https://dcms.tirallab.page. It requires internet access and stores its database on the server. Sales Manager records operations and CEO reviews records without write access. See the manual for exact workflows. Site availability depends on the app and proxy services being running. Stop and resume procedures are documented in DEPLOYMENT.md.

items: Future delivery. Build and verify the standalone installed application, including operation without internet.
Unimplemented target features. Automated encrypted nightly cloud backup, sale voids and refunds, full fiscal integration and immutable per-operator financial audit.
Acceptance work. Verify target physical printing, receipt fields, detailed tax treatment and business review of the requirements and reports.
Presentation readiness. Rehearse within fifteen minutes and prepare individual contribution and Q&A answers.

Proposed inventory observation. Physical counts and production, loading, damage and returns should be checked if further access becomes possible. These checks were not performed during the original visit.

blocks.text: Word documents use Times New Roman at 12 pt with 1.15 line spacing, A4 pages and 25.4 mm margins. Slides retain the white background and Arial style. Requirement, story and epic identifiers, URLs and file names retain their literal punctuation.
Regeneration commands and the existing build scripts are documented in README.md. Render and inspect the deliverables after changes.
